kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خُنْفُسَاء الْخِيَارِ الْمُخَطَّطَة • (ḵunfusāʔ al-ḵiyāri l-muḵaṭṭaṭa) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: By surface analysis, خُنْفُسَاء الْخِيَارِ (ḵunfusāʔ al-ḵiyāri, “cucumber beetle”) + مُخَطَّط (muḵaṭṭaṭ, “striped”), literally “striped cucumber beetle”.
